title: Session-Based Next-Item Recommendation

blueprintSignals.name: Last-k item embeddings
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Cap sequence length so latency stays inside the budget

blueprintSignals.name: Dwell and scroll depth
blueprintSignals.definition: seconds on item pages and scroll fraction
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Bots inflate or deflate dwell, so filter them first

blueprintSignals.name: Session goal inference
blueprintSignals.definition: classifier over browse vs compare vs purchase
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Label from the eventual purchase carefully to avoid leakage

blueprintSignals.name: Session theme category
blueprintSignals.definition: share of recent items in each category
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Compute from the prefix only, never including the item to be predicted

blueprintSignals.name: Transition recency
blueprintSignals.definition: how recently each item-to-item transition was observed, decayed over days
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Decay by event time and keep the training cut-off before the test window

label: For "Session-Based Next-Item Recommendation": Recommend the next item for anonymous or logged-in sessions in real time, using only in-session behaviour when history is absent. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Random session splits leak popularity.
